title: Fabrication and osteogenic differentiation performance of the electrospun magnetic P(VDF-TrFE)/Fe3O4 composite fibrous membranes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28604-28618
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01554A, Paper
Open Access

Na Qiang, Lihong Huang, Wenlong Zhang, Rouping Zheng, Yan Yu, Jiao Zou, Qingyun Tang, Yubo Zou, Jinyu Yang, Guocong Liu, Shuai Qiu, Shuo Tang
Fe3O4-OA was incorporated into P(VDF-TrFE) fibers via electrospinning. The resulting membranes exhibited a bone-like topological structure and physiological surface potential, showing cytocompatibility and great potential for bone defect repair.
